info.title: Ai no Kusabi (2012)
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata ad Amoi, un pianeta controllato da un supercomputer denominato Jupiter. Al comando vi è un’elite di statuari uomini dai capelli chiari: i "Blondies", essi non possono intrattenere relazioni sessuali, quindi tengono presso di loro gli impuri "Mongrels" dai capelli scuri dei ghetti, per puro voyeurismo. Non è permesso avere un impuro per periodi prolungati, dopo un po’ di tempo vengono ricambiati come i giocattoli vecchi. Tuttavia Iason, un membro della casta dominante, trattiene il suo animaletto personale, Riki, per un periodo non più socialmente accettabile e non lo punisce adeguatamente quando disubbidisce, così cominciano a spargersi insistenti voci che egli si sia affezionato al suo schiavo...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
In the central city of Tanagra, which is ruled by the enormous computer Jupiter, Riki was held captive in the Eos Tower, the residential area of the privileged class. He was kept as a pet by one of the most elite artificial beings, a blonde individual known as Iason Mink. Despite having his freedom and dignity stripped away and undergoing inappropriate training, Riki refused to be tamed and resisted those around him.

Then, one day, while Riki stood in front of the heavily guarded entrance gate of Eos, a door that should never have opened suddenly did. In this unprecedented escape event initiated by Riki, Iason was faced with a dilemma...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: In the outskirts of the pleasure city, Midas, lies the special autonomous district of Keres. Within the harsh class-based society, this area, situated at the lowest rung, is commonly referred to as the Slums. Riki, who had been returned to his old stomping grounds in the Slums by Iason after three years, reunites with his former comrades. Among them is Guy, the only partner Riki ever opened up to. Riki, who once led the delinquent group "Bison" and exuded an overwhelming presence, returns to the Slums, accompanied by unpleasant rumors spreading throughout the area. Despite not offering any explanations, Riki occasionally displays a troubled expression. Guy senses a subtle transformation in Riki's demeanor.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
Kirie, the new addition to Guy's group, harbored a sense of rivalry towards Riki, who had returned to the Slums. Riki, coerced by Kirie, agrees to go to a pet auction where humanoid pleasure toys are being offered for sale. Unable to forget his past humiliations, Riki becomes increasingly frustrated by Kirie's behavior and his expressed desire to "rise to the top."

On the other hand, Iason, who had released Riki and refrained from having a pet, was also headed to the auction venue upon the recommendation of a fellow Blondie, Raoul. In a city adorned with extravagance and desire, Riki and Iason once again cross paths...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Riki unexpectedly reunites with Iason at the pet auction venue. Unable to conceal his shock, Riki drinks at a run-down shot bar on the outskirts while vividly recalling bitter memories of pleasure and suffering. It all began three years ago on that fateful night. Riki, a streetwise Slum mongrel, would steal valuables from the crowds, then race through the unending nightlife of the city of Midas. Seeking both sustenance for survival and the thrill of the hunt, he scouted for easy targets. Suddenly, someone grabbed his wrist from behind. With a chilling tone, the one who had captured him was none other than Iason, a Blondie who stood at the pinnacle of the privileged class...

related.title: Il Cuneo Dell'amore (ITA)
related.plot: Riki non ne poteva più della vita senza futuro nel ghetto di Keres, e aveva deciso di abbandonare il suo amico Guy e la banda dei Bysons per cercare fortuna e libertà a Tanagura, la megalopoli governata dal computer Jupiter. Da allora sono passati tre anni, quando improvvisamente Riki torna a Keres. I suoi occhi sono più freddi, il suo spirito ribelle sembra sottomesso. Cosa è successo in quei costosi condomini di Tanagura, dove si dice che la casta dominante dei Blondies, statuari giganti dal corpo artificiale, usi gli impuri dei ghetti come giocattoli sessuali? e perchè ora il Blondie Lason Mink sta tentando in tutti i modi di riportare Riki a Tanagura?
